title: Stage dispatch and settlement
summary: A run settles its own target after required delivery and gates pass. A member still owing another named target's post-deploy QA or manual acceptance stays open, with no fabricated pass or waiver. Refusals name the item, requirement, phase, target and recovery. Lost responses remain unknown: read the exact preparation receipt or existing provider attempt before retrying or failing; pending attempts are preserved. Fleet preparation exposes current subphases, pending heartbeats, elapsed time and reader counts in the existing driver capture. Copy-scoped batches preserve every canonical reader check and physical connection closure. When a bounded scoped-QA wait ends with blockers, the driver retains the awaiting-QA outcome even if the subsequent diagnostic report read fails. It labels fresh details unavailable and preserves the last known blocker diagnostic without fresh counts, success or gate waiver.
